title: v18 upgrade: stored views with data.provider 'api' are refused at rehydration with no conversion — the upgrade should migrate or report them
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`) under ruling objectstack-ai/cloud#2866 A (`6146394952`). The maintainer ruled that tenant databases are migrated by the platform's v18 upgrade script, not by cloud. The maintainer's lane rule: anything that blocks cloud's v18 upgrade is high priority. Source: the cloud re-pin report objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 `6145524807` (`data_shape_changes`), at framework `01a3421f42`.

## What happens

- **The change:** `1912af47ba` (#23160) refuses a stored view row whose `data.provider` is `'api'` (with `read` / `write` blocks) at rehydration. It gives a prescription, but it deliberately ships no D2 conversion, because the replacement lives on a page element.
- **Read only:** cloud's code writes no such view. Whether tenant-authored rows exist was not measured; cloud's upgrade rehearsal (objectstack-ai/cloud#2867) will count them.

## Ask

The v18 upgrade either moves such a view to the page-element form the prescription names, or lists it in the ceremony's report so an owner can act. A silently unserved view is what to avoid. If the lane judges that no deployment can hold such rows, closing this with that evidence is fine.
